sentences.en: In the essay, each body paragraph should focus on one main idea.
sentences.zh: 在文章中，每个正文段落应该集中论述一个主要观点。

sentences.en: The body paragraphs provide supporting evidence for the thesis statement.
sentences.zh: 正文段落为论点陈述提供支持证据。

sentences.en: She added a new body paragraph to strengthen her argument.
sentences.zh: 她增加了一个新的正文段落来加强她的论据。
